references.text: 1 Chronicles lists the same cities given to the tribe of Simeon, including Hazar-Shual, Balah and Ezem, as a parallel account of Simeon's inheritance.
Hazar-Shual is mentioned as one of the cities in the tribe of Judah's inheritance in the Negev region, showing that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's territory.
The context shows that the tribe of Simeon received their inheritance from Judah's lot because Judah's portion was too large for them.
Hazar-Shual is mentioned as one of the cities where Judah's descendants settled after the exile, confirming the city's historical significance.
